status: Reviewable design prototype; backend contracts are specified, not implemented

implementation_baseline.identity: Original Nest mark with solid circular egg
implementation_baseline.data_policy: All financial values in these screens are explicit illustrative fixtures. No quote, APR/APY, TVL, history, fee, address or availability shown here is a live product claim.
implementation_baseline.backend_boundary: The repository's application preset and deployed Worker integration remain pending. Endpoint names below are documented contracts, not verified operational services.
implementation_baseline.asset_identity: Resolve network, issuer, SAC/contract and decimals from the verified registry. A ticker alone never establishes an executable asset.
implementation_baseline.approval: All financial entry points create typed intents and use the shared ActionReviewSheet. The preview has no wallet, network requests, signature or transaction path.

screens.title: Trade
screens.purpose: Inspect reference price context, compare executable routes at the actual input amount and review one exact-input swap.

layout.desktop: Market header above OHLC chart / route comparison / 340px ticket. My positions sits below the chart and routes; the ticket spans both rows.
layout.medium: At workspace widths 901–1100px, route options and My positions move beneath the chart, with the ticket at right. At 900px and below, chart, routes, ticket and positions stack.
layout.mobile: Single column with a visible pair, price and source context. Controls meet 44px targets. No orderbook squeeze. Ticket follows chart and route context.
layout.assistant: Follow AppShell behavior: dock only at sufficient width; otherwise overlay so the chart, route region and ticket do not become three narrow columns.

chart: Right price axis and last reference-price marker
UTC time axis, crosshair, keyboard inspection, zoom, pan and Fit
Clearly labeled deterministic OHLC fixtures; never construct real candles from sparse price samples
route: Eligible and excluded routes with reasons
ticket: Exact input amount as decimal string
positions: My positions heading; positions / pending / history tabs
USD notional with valuation timestamp and currency assumption
Average entry, mark and signed unrealized P&L / percentage
Full-position close enters the shared exact-input swap review

interactions: Selecting a pair or reversing direction obtains a fresh quote set for that exact input asset and amount.
Amount, route, wallet, network or saved policy changes invalidate the prepared review; no stale quote remains signable.
Route selection shows its own expected output, bounds and fees. Excluded routes remain visible with reasons.
The interval changes historical chart context, never executable quote bounds.
Activity tabs expose positions, pending workflows and confirmed swap history; a submitted action is never labeled confirmed.
The preview's amount presets, route selection and refresh are local fixture interactions only.
Candle interval changes displayed OHLC; zoom/pan/Fit and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight inspect the chart independently from quotes.
Close uses the full available quantity, obtains a fresh exact-input quote in production, then opens the shared review. No holding or P&L changes until the confirmed receipt.
Preview selector demonstrates sample position, missing cost basis and disconnected wallet.

states.loading: Skeleton reference metrics and route progress; disable financial review until the quote set is valid.
states.partial: Preserve successful routes; show unavailable/excluded routes and reasons.
states.no_route: Explain pair, capacity, policy or liquidity constraints and offer explicit input edits.
states.stale_or_expired: Show observation time and effective expiry; disable review/sign and refresh a new revision.
states.wallet_or_network_mismatch: Identify expected scope and invalidate the old prepared plan.
states.awaiting_signature: Retain exact token deltas, bounds, fees and expiry while the wallet is open.
states.submitted_or_reconciling: Show transaction/receipt evidence and durable progress without claiming a fill.
states.partial_completion: Show completed effects and remaining exposure; recovery is separately reviewed.
states.confirmed: Show actual input/output and charged fees from the confirmed receipt, then refresh positions.

screens.title: Earn opportunity navigation
screens.purpose: Filter and compare direct lending, curated vaults and campaigns before selecting a product-specific action page.

layout.desktop: Category row above a 248px left filter rail and horizontally arranged opportunity rows. Sort bar spans the results column.
layout.row: Identity and curator; net yield/methodology; Stellar TVL/source; withdrawal condition; separate detail action.
layout.medium: Exit context can wrap under the identity rather than forcing small type. Filters become a sheet below 1024px.
layout.mobile: Stack row facts into two labeled columns; keep product identity first and the detail action full width.

filters: Risk profile: All / Lower / Moderate / Higher / Unrated
content_rules: Net yield is accompanied by methodology; base yield and incentives remain separate on detail.
Do not copy reference leveraged-stock, option or derivatives product categories into P0.
Use approved markets/products across Blend, Templar, XOXNO, DeFindex, Upshift/Gami and Sentora.
Provider, curator and underlying protocol are separate identities.
An unavailable yield is labeled unavailable rather than zero or an invented APY.
Campaign rewards are not annualized without an actual supported methodology.
interactions: Search, category, asset, risk profile and exit filters combine
Sort by supported metric with unavailable values last
Detail links preserve exact product identity
Unsupported/paused product remains inspectable with execution disabled and a reason
Production search/filter/sort/pagination is controlled and server-backed

states.empty: Explain active filters and offer reset
states.partial: Retain successful products and show missing providers
states.stale: Show source age; disable action where required

risk_profile.preserved: Underlying yield breakdown and pre-action withdrawal terms on product detail/review.

screens.title: Per-vault / per-product detail
screens.purpose: Combine user reference images 3–5 into one page that explains the product, its position and the full supported entry/exit lifecycle.

layout.desktop: Main content with a 340px right action ticket; long-page sections retain one product context. Ticket sticks while reviewing on desktop.
layout.mobile: Ticket moves below product context rather than squeezing beside it. Context panels and process/risk groups stack. Keep withdrawal disclosure visible before the review action.

direct_supply.accounting: Venue-native balances and collateral/debt effects; no universal vault-share or health-factor assumptions
direct_supply.exit: Available liquidity, native collateral constraints and venue-specific queue/settlement

share_vault.accounting: Verified share decimals/conversion and net asset value; receipt and backing are not double-counted
share_vault.exit: Actual product request/settlement/claim model, fees and earliest availability

campaign.accounting: Separate deposit lots, accrued and claimable rewards, release conditions and forfeiture
campaign.exit: Selected-lot timing and exact rewards forfeited; no assumed shares or instant redemption

withdrawal_disclosure.placement: Beside deposit amount, above the review action, and repeated in the shared prepared review. Never only a tooltip or collapsed technical section.
withdrawal_disclosure.behavior: Refresh on product, amount and preview changes. Unknown and variable timing remain prominent. Material changes require a new review.

interaction: Product identity is selected from the exact opportunity row; direct navigation resolves the canonical opportunity ID.
Deposit/Withdraw/Claim controls appear only for adapter-supported capabilities and the current product state.
Switching action updates required amount units, disclosures, fee components and position effects.
Changing amount invalidates prepared data and requires new checks/simulation.
Delayed redemption exposes request amount, pending state, actual earliest availability and separately available settlement/claim action.
Campaign withdrawal selects lots and shows accrued versus claimable versus forfeited rewards.
FAQ and contract details are expandable; essential exit facts remain visible.
The preview product selector is a design-review convenience, not a proposed production control.

states.paused: Block new entries while preserving supported exits and visibility
states.confirmed: Use actual receipt effects and refresh positions
